newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Union says Highveld Steel strike at end.
newsitem.headline: Union says Highveld Steel strike at end.

text.p: The National Union of Metalworkers of South Africa (Numsa) said on Tuesday 2,000 striking workers at Highveld Steel and Vanadium Corp Ltd had agreed to return to work.
The union members went on strike last Thursday after a black artisan assistant was allegedly assaulted by a white supervisor.

On Tuesday the union said the striking workers agreed to return to work on condition that the black worker, who was given the same punishment as the white supervisor, was allowed to return to work and the final written warning given to him be scrapped.
"The parties are currently drawing up the terms of reference for the mediator so that mediation can take place during this week," the union said.
